name: Wiggle title
what: A one- or two-line title whose letters never stand still: a wave of squash and stretch runs through them, or they boil like a hand drawing; the second line in four colours.

learned_from.what: the letters' heights in a travelling wave, the four-colour second line
the hand-drawn boil: a new pose every 3 frames

motion: letters pop in 2 f apart (10 f, back.out), a 54 f wave, out 16 f
